table_description: Dimension table containing postal addresses for customers. Each row is one address record. Customers can have multiple historical addresses but C_CURRENT_ADDR_SK in the CUSTOMER table points to the most recent one. Used for geographic segmentation of sales.
use_cases: Customer geographic distribution by state, city, or country
data_quality_notes: CA_GMT_OFFSET is a numeric offset from GMT (e.g. -5 for EST) — useful for time-zone-aware analysis.
CA_STATE is a 2-letter US state code for US addresses.
CA_COUNTRY is 'United States' for most records in this dataset.
Join using CA_ADDRESS_SK — used in STORE_SALES (SS_ADDR_SK), CATALOG_SALES (CS_BILL_ADDR_SK, CS_SHIP_ADDR_SK), WEB_SALES (WS_BILL_ADDR_SK, WS_SHIP_ADDR_SK).

table_columns.name: CA_ADDRESS_SK
table_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Referenced by all sales fact tables.

table_columns.name: CA_STREET_TYPE
table_columns.description: Street type: Ave, Blvd, St, Rd, etc.

table_columns.name: CA_SUITE_NUMBER
table_columns.description: Apartment or suite number. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: CA_CITY
table_columns.description: City name. Use for city-level geographic analysis.

table_columns.name: CA_STATE
table_columns.description: 2-letter state code (US). Use for state-level regional analysis.

table_columns.name: CA_COUNTRY
table_columns.description: Country name. Mostly 'United States' in this dataset.

table_columns.name: CA_GMT_OFFSET
table_columns.description: GMT offset as a decimal (e.g. -5.0 for EST). Useful for timezone analysis.

table_columns.name: CA_LOCATION_TYPE
table_columns.description: Type of residence: apartment, house, condo, unknown. Can be NULL.
